reels.title: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing

editorial_notes.reasoning: Fits the 'hardware_efficiency' category with a 1.16x multiplier; the 'dynamic chunk-wise mixing' concept is perfect for 3b1b-style geometric visualizations of fluid flow or compressed data buffers.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if your AI's memory could expand and contract like a breathing lung to process infinite data?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: A library archive that automatically compresses old books into tiny, high-density microfilm when the shelves get full.
